name: comfyui-mcp
title_zh: 自然语言改工作流，178 个工具随叫随到
tagline_zh: ComfyUI 的连线劝退过无数人。装上它用说话就能生成图/视频/音频、搭工作流、改你正在跑的节点图，全程本地不上传素材。
tagline_en: A local-first control plane for ComfyUI — an MCP server plus sidebar agent that generates media, authors and runs workflows, and edits your live graph in plain language.
desc_en: Local-first, agent-native control plane for ComfyUI — MCP server + sidebar agent that generates images, video & audio, authors and runs workflows, and edits your live graph in natural language on ANY LLM (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, offline Ollama, or any hosted model). 178 tools, 36 AI skills, 55 installer packs. Local, LAN, VPS, or Comfy Cloud.
why_zh: 把「拖节点」变成「说人话」，而且本地跑——碰私密素材时这点关键。
why_en: ComfyUI's node-wiring scares people off; this turns dragging nodes into plain talk, fully local, nothing uploaded.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

limit_zh: 本体是 npm 上的 MCP server，39 件 skill 给它当外围。前提是有一台跑着 ComfyUI 的机器——没有 ComfyUI，这一整包一件都用不上。另外推荐管线里含一个 abliterated（去掉了拒答方向）的文本编码器 LoRA，作者标它是修脸用的；模型表另有一行 abliterated 出图模型标着 uncensored，可换成同表的普通写实模型。
limit_en: The product is an npm MCP server (node ≥22); the 39 skills under plugin/skills are its periphery. You need a running ComfyUI — local, LAN, VPS or Comfy Cloud. Without one, none of it does anything.
title_en: Drive ComfyUI workflows by plain language, 178 tools ready
